source: LZ Collaboration, arXiv:2609.02823v1 (2026), Fig. S2, PDF page 14
extraction_method: vector-path extraction from the black final WIMP-search ROI curve
digitization_note: The vector curve gives a low-energy 50% crossing near 5.09 keV, whereas the paper text/caption quotes 5.4 keV from Ref. [5]; the extracted curve is 57.18% at 5.4 keV. The high-energy crossing near 269.87 keV agrees with 269.9 keV. The mean final-ROI efficiency over 14--250 keV is 95.47%, about 0.53 percentage points below the paper's quoted 96%; this small difference is retained explicitly rather than rescaling the curve.
rate_level_use: Use the digitized black final-ROI curve for preliminary efficiency-weighted event yields; the 5.4 keV published ROI boundary and low-energy crossing discrepancy must be reported. This curve does not replace the two-dimensional S1c/log10(S2c) PDFs or likelihood.
